title: WAL-RUS: a Rust Rewrite of WAL-G for PostgreSQL Backups
summary: WAL-RUS is ClickHouse's Rust-based rewrite of WAL-G, a popular tool for PostgreSQL backup and restore operations using Write-Ahead Logging, aiming to improve performance and reliability through Rust's memory safety features.
problem_solved: Provides high-performance, memory-safe PostgreSQL backup and restore capabilities using Write-Ahead Logging.
why_valuable: Rust's performance and safety guarantees make it ideal for critical database infrastructure, reducing memory-related errors in backup operations.
